_how_to_use: Pointers plus bidder scope language. OPEN the scope narrative, the spec sections and the sheets -- do not draft from this record's titles alone. Do NOT enumerate drawings in the exhibit; the sheet lists here tell you what to read, not what to write.
document_authority_hierarchy: 1. Addenda & Clarifications supersede everything they touch. Addendum #1 (05.06.26) reissued G0-00, LS1-10, A1-20, A2-10, A10-30, C1 and GD. Exhibit B Basis of GMP (07.01.26) is a contract document treated as an addendum (PM ruling 08.04.26).
2. The Scope of Work narrative decides WHICH PACKAGE carries an item. It is the trade-boundary authority.
3. Specifications decide HOW the work is executed.
4. Drawings show extent and location. Weakest authority for assignment.

Subcontractor proposals are NOT in this hierarchy. They surface the assumptions a bidder made and expose gaps. Where a proposal contradicts a contract document, FLAG it -- never silently adopt the proposal's position or narrow the subcontract to match it. Ignore general/boilerplate exclusions.

scope_narrative.note: PRIMARY trade-boundary authority. Read this first and in full.

primary.title: Concrete Formwork
primary.rationale: Formwork is the concrete package's means and methods.

primary.title: Concrete Reinforcement
primary.rationale: Reinforcement is placed by the concrete package.

primary.title: Cast-In-Place Concrete
primary.rationale: Cast-in-place concrete is RFP-030. Eleven packages cite this section because each has equipment set on a concrete footing; those are cross-references to RFP-030's work, not claims on it. PM rulings 07.31.26 confirm the direction: athletic equipment and goal post footings, and concrete curb and slot/trench drains at the track perimeter, are all RFP-030.

primary.title: Vapor Retarders
primary.rationale: Cited solely by RFP-030 -- the under-slab vapour retarder is placed with the slab.

primary.title: Concrete Paving
primary.rationale: Cited solely by RFP-030. TAB's homework response deducts Type II from the concrete paving, confirming RFP-008 carries the subgrade and RFP-030 the slab.

primary.title: Sidewalks
primary.rationale: Sidewalks are flatwork. RFP-008 and RFP-016 reach it only through a division-level mention of Division 32.

added_by_pm_ruling.title: Earth Moving
added_by_pm_ruling.rationale: Thirteen scope docs mention Division 31, because each has to trench, backfill or compact for its own work. RFP-008 is the mass-earthwork package and carries the section; the others comply with it inside their own excavations.

flow_down_from_other_packages.title: Joint Sealants
flow_down_from_other_packages.note: Every package seals its own joints and penetrations to this section.

32 11 23.note: Aggregate Base Courses. Absent. CLOSED BY PM RULING 08.05.26: aggregate base courses are covered in 31 20 00 Earth Moving, which is RFP-008's section -- consistent with TAB pricing the Type II deducts under the turf field, building pad and concrete paving. RFP-030 references it for base under its flatwork.
